title: Suzanne's mother moves the family to Aztec after reading Scully
place_text: Flora Vista, near Aztec, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Suzanne was born in South Dakota to a mother who was obsessed [music] with UFOs, an obsession sparked by the first book on Aztec, Behind the Flying Saucers, by variety columnist Frank [music] Scully. Suzanne's mother was so inspired by Scully that she moved the entire [music] family to Flora Vista, a suburb of Aztec.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a woman named Suzanne, born in South Dakota to a mother obsessed with UFOs. According to Michels, the obsession began with Behind the Flying Saucers, the first book about a saucer said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, written by a show-business columnist named Frank Scully. He says the mother was so taken with it that she moved the whole family to Flora Vista, a suburb of Aztec, which brings Suzanne's story right to the place where the crash is said to have happened.
